_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-26 on the refactor/lean-fit branch. Paper Sec. 5.1-5.2. The interventional means are analytic (E[x3|do(x2=a)] = -0.25 + 0.25a), so what is checked is the flow's error against them, not a pinned flow value: a center plus an error bound on the same number gave two windows that could disagree. do(x2=-3) is off-manifold extrapolation, which is why its error is the largest of the three. Exact reference protocol since 2026-08-26 (global ReduceLROnPlateau, glorot init): the do(x2=-3) error is seed-sensitive — 0.098 at the config's init seed 7, 0.268 / 0.217 at seeds 8 / 9 — so the bound is 2.5x the seed-7 value and docs/paper-replication.md holds the spread.
